detail.longDescription: DoorDash’s Flux Runs 130,000 Engineering Tasks through Cloud-Based Agents DoorDash moved engineering agent tasks from laptops to Flux cloud platform, automating 130K tasks monthly & 25K weekly code reviews. The secure system uses isolated micro VMs, cloud sandboxes & reusable playbooks. Key features: sub-5 second setup, strict permissions & full logging. Expanding beyond code reviews to CI triage & maintenance workflows. https://www. infoq.com/news/2026/08/doordas h-flux-cloud-agent/ # AI # MachineLearning # DevOps
